inputs: master.csv row: pe_ttm,rev_yoy,market_cap (score selection + Altman x4)
a_financials.csv: revenue,profit,profit_yoy,rev_yoy,gross_margin + a_cashflow_annual.csv: ocf,capex + a_balance.csv: rece_yoy (A partial)

lineage.source: Piotroski 2000 (F) / Mohanram 2005 (G) / Beneish 1999 (M) / Dechow et al. 1995 (modified Jones) / Roychowdhury 2006 (real EM) / Altman 1968 (Z)
lineage.note: 三层法医: strength (F/G 自动选择) + fraud (Beneish + Jones-lite + Roychowdhury-lite 交叉验证) + distress (Altman partial x4/x5)

limits: coverage honest: score reported x/available(of canonical), never rescaled to a pseudo-9/8
US Piotroski 3/9 computable (assets_prev/liab_prev/gm_prev/shares/current-ratio gaps); A 4/9 with named proxies (profit>0 for ROA, profit_yoy>0 for dROA) + FY-ocf vs interim-profit period mismatch
Beneish canonical M-score never computable (DSRI/GMI/AQI/DEPI/SGAI/LVGI gaps); US 2/8 (SGI,TATA), A 2/8 (SGI,DSRI-approx), HK 1/8 (SGI)
Jones-lite & Roychowdhury-lite US-only (assets absent in A/HK); production-cost & discretionary-expense detectors declared gaps
Altman 2/5 components (x4,x5 US only) — no canonical Z verdict
红灯可否决，绿灯不构成买入理由 — veto instrument, never a ranking key
